description: Parkeringar is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tjörns kommun. Data on car parks on public land. Information on geographical location and type of parking. Coverage: Tjörns kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Parking lots" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tjörns kommun. Its keywords include parkeringsplatser, parkeringar, parking lots, parking spots. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
